detail.longDescription: YIL about immich-admin commands to take Immich in and out of maintenance mode (much like Nextcloud has had for as long as I remember) , e.g.: $ docker exec -it immich_server immich-admin enable-maintenance-mode If you have a Immich browser window open, you'll get notified immidiately. This mode change is useful when putting a borg backup script together. The commands are documented here: https:// docs.immich.app/administration /server-commands # immich # docker # backup # borg
